name: MonarchBarChart
title: BarChart
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas (DrawScope.drawPath, drawLine, drawRoundRect) with androidx.compose.ui.text.TextMeasurer and drawText; inside MonarchChartFrame with MonarchChartLegend and MonarchChartTable
summary: A bar or column chart of one or more series per category, grouped or stacked, vertical or horizontal, with value labels, a highlighted category, reference lines, touch inspection, legend toggles, drill-in and the data as a table.
whenToUse: To compare amounts across a handful of categories or periods, or to show how a few series make up each category's total.
whenNotToUse: For a ranked list of labelled values with no axis, use MonarchBarList. For a word-sized trend use MonarchSparkline. For parts of one whole, use MonarchDonutChart.
api: @Composable fun MonarchBarChart(title: String, categories: List<String>, series: List<MonarchBarChartSeries>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, description: String? = null, categoryTitle: String? = null, summary: String? = null, orientation: MonarchBarChartOrientation = MonarchBarChartOrientation.Vertical, layout: MonarchBarChartLayout = MonarchBarChartLayout.Grouped, status: MonarchChartFrameStatus = MonarchChartFrameStatus.Ready, hiddenSeries: Set<String>? = null, onHiddenSeriesChange: ((Set<String>) -> Unit)? = null, highlightedIndex: Int? = null, referenceLines: List<MonarchBarChartReferenceLine> = emptyList(), valueRange: ClosedFloatingPointRange<Double>? = null, showValueLabels: Boolean = false, legendToggle: Boolean = true, tableToggle: Boolean = true, emptyMessage: String? = null, footer: String? = null, height: Dp? = null, labels: MonarchBarChartLabels = MonarchBarChartLabels(), formatValue: ((Double) -> String)? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onSelect: ((Int) -> Unit)? = null)
class MonarchBarChartSeries(key: String, label: String, values: List<Double?>, color: MonarchChartColor? = null)
class MonarchBarChartReferenceLine(value: Double, label: String? = null)

class MonarchBarChartLabels(frame: MonarchChartFrameLabels = MonarchChartFrameLabels(), category: String? = null, total: String? = null, noData: String? = null, details: String? = null, clearSelection: String? = null, highlighted: String? = null)

options.name: title
options.description: The chart's name: the frame heading and the plot's spoken name.

options.name: categories
options.description: The categories in display order, already formatted by the app (dates, months, names).

options.name: series
options.description: The measures: a key, a label, one value per category and an optional color slot.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the frame.

options.name: description
options.description: One line under the title.

options.name: categoryTitle
options.description: The heading of the category column of the table.

options.name: summary
options.description: Replaces the generated spoken summary.

options.name: orientation
options.description: Vertical columns or Horizontal bars.

options.name: layout
options.description: With several series, Grouped side by side or Stacked.

options.name: status
options.description: Ready, Loading, Empty or Error. Ready with no categories or no series shows Empty.

options.name: hiddenSeries
options.description: The keys of hidden series. null lets the chart keep its own set (rememberSaveable), changed by the legend.

options.name: onHiddenSeriesChange
options.description: Called with the new hidden set when the legend changes it, in both modes.

options.name: highlightedIndex
options.description: A category to emphasise: the bars of the others take the disabled text color and TalkBack reads "Highlighted" on it.

options.name: referenceLines
options.description: Dashed lines across the bars at a value, with an optional label.

options.name: valueRange
options.description: Fixes the value axis. null fits the values, zero and the reference lines to round ticks.

options.name: showValueLabels
options.description: Writes each bar's value at its end; a stack shows its net total once.

options.name: legendToggle
options.description: Whether legend entries show and hide their series. The legend appears with two or more series; without toggles it lists only the series that are drawn.

options.name: tableToggle
options.description: Whether "View as table" is offered.

options.name: emptyMessage
options.description: The message of the empty state.

options.name: footer
options.description: Notes under the chart.

options.name: height
options.description: The plot height: 240dp for columns; 32dp per category plus one, at least 120dp, for horizontal bars.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings, including the frame's.

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Writes values on the axis, in value labels, the inspection row, TalkBack, the table and the summary. By default a number in the current locale, compact ("1.2K") on the axis and the bars.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Shows Try again in the error status.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Drill-in: called with the category index from Details in the inspection row or from the TalkBack action "Details, <category>".

states.name: ready
states.description: The plot with value gridlines, the legend (two or more series) and "View as table".

states.name: inspecting
states.description: After a tap on the plot, or a drag along columns: the category's band is shaded with the muted background and a row under the plot shows its values (and the stack total), announced politely, with Details (when onSelect is set) and Clear. It stays until Clear or another category is touched.

states.name: highlighted
states.description: With highlightedIndex, the bars of the other categories take the disabled text color; TalkBack reads "Highlighted" on the highlighted category.

states.name: series hidden
states.description: A hidden series is not drawn, read or summarised; its legend chip reads "Hidden" and is struck through. The table still lists it.

states.name: table
states.description: "View as table" replaces the plot with every category and series as text, plus a Total column when two or more series are stacked.

states.name: loading
states.description: The frame's skeleton of the plot's height, read as "Loading chart".

states.name: empty
states.description: MonarchEmptyState with "No data yet" and the empty message; also shown when there are no categories or no series.

states.name: error
states.description: The frame's error, with Try again when onRetry is set.

appearance: Bars take the theme's data colors 1 to 5 in series order, then the subtle text color, with the far end rounded. Gridlines use the subtle border color, the zero line the strong border color, tick, category and value labels the muted text color in the caption style. Reference lines are dashed in the subtle text color. The inspected band uses the muted background; dimmed bars use the disabled text color. Every color is a theme role, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes are covered.
platformNotes: Android has no first-party chart library and Monarch adds none, so the chart is drawn with a Compose Canvas (iOS uses Swift Charts, the web hand-drawn SVG). Positions are computed from the start edge and mirrored when drawn, so the chart reads right to left in RTL locales; text is drawn unmirrored. Android has no chart descriptor like iOS's AXChartDescriptor (Audio Graphs): TalkBack gets a summary on the plot, one element per category it can swipe through, and the table. The highlight is drawn with the disabled color rather than iOS's reduced opacity, because Monarch never dims with transparency. hiddenSeries is either controlled (with onHiddenSeriesChange) or kept by the chart; iOS uses a Binding. Not offered: the web's keyboard arrow navigation and controlled activeIndex, date categories formatted by the chart (the app formats categories), dashed series, and iOS's valueTitle (there is no value axis for TalkBack to name). Horizontal bars inspect on tap only, so a vertical drag still scrolls the screen.
accessibility: The plot is one element with the image role, named by the title, whose state description is the generated summary (number and range of categories, each shown series' total and highest category, each reference line) or the summary parameter.
After it, one element per category in category order (traversal index), read as the category and each shown series' value, with "No value" for a gap and the total of a stack of two or more series.
With onSelect, each category element has a TalkBack custom action named "Details, <category>"; without it the elements have no action.
The highlighted category's element has the state description "Highlighted", so the highlight is not shown by color alone.
The inspection row is a polite live region followed by MonarchButton controls (Details, Clear) with touch targets of at least 48dp.
The legend is MonarchChartLegend: each entry is a filter chip with the state "Shown" or "Hidden"; the last shown series cannot be hidden.
"View as table" shows every value as text; each table row is read as the category, then each series and its value.
Category elements and taps are mirrored in right to left, so the first category is at the start edge.
edgeCases: Gaps (null) and values that are not finite draw no bar, are read "No value" and shown "—" in the table, and are left out of the summary.
Negative values draw below (or before) the zero line; in a stack they stack down from zero apart from the positive values, and a stack's value label shows the net total at the end of the larger side.
More than five series: the sixth and later take the neutral color, as in the legend.
Category labels that do not fit are cut with an ellipsis, and with many columns only every n-th label is drawn; the full names are in the category elements, the inspection row and the table.
A highlightedIndex outside the categories dims every bar.
The inspection row takes room from the plot inside the frame's fixed height; at the largest font size the plot gets shorter.
With a valueRange that excludes some values, bars are drawn beyond the plot edge; the values are still read and listed.
TalkBack navigation, the custom actions and the drag gesture were checked only with Robolectric semantics tests, not on a device with TalkBack.

examples.title: Grouped columns
Stacked horizontal bars with totals, legend owned by the app, drill-in
examples.code:
MonarchBarChart(
    title = "Tickets by team",
    categories = teams,
    series = listOf(
        MonarchBarChartSeries("open", "Open", listOf(42.0, 18.0, 27.0)),
        MonarchBarChartSeries("closed", "Closed", listOf(120.0, 64.0, 88.0)),
    ),
    categoryTitle = "Team",
    orientation = MonarchBarChartOrientation.Horizontal,
    layout = MonarchBarChartLayout.Stacked,
    hiddenSeries = hidden,
    onHiddenSeriesChange = { hidden = it },
    showValueLabels = true,
    footer = opened?.let { "Opened $it" },
    onSelect = { opened = teams[it] },
)

examples.title: One series with the current month highlighted
examples.code:
MonarchBarChart(
    title = "Signups",
    categories = listOf("Apr", "May", "Jun"),
    series = listOf(MonarchBarChartSeries("signups", "Signups", listOf(52.0, 47.0, 60.0))),
    highlightedIndex = 2,
    height = 160.dp,
)

parityExceptions.reason: The axis labels are drawn on the chart canvas, where the preview shows them, and are not separate nodes for TalkBack; the chart carries one description and a View as table button that give every value.
parityExceptions.convention: chart axes are canvas drawing with a summary description and a table alternative (Material charts guidance)
